Card Q&A.a:
This card's effect reduces the digivolution cost by 2, and the total digivolution cost reduction when combined with BT3-103 [Hidden Potential Discovered!]   is 7.
                                            
                        Related Cards
Card Q&A.q: I used BT3-103 [Hidden Potential Discovered!],   then I played this card. I then used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend 1 other Digimon. If I use BT3-103 [Hidden Potential Discovered!]'s   effect to suspend one of my Digimon other than this card when I use the part of the effect after "then" to digivolve this card, how much is the digivolution cost reduced by this card's effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if it's your turn, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits in the hand. For every other suspended Digimon, reduce this effect's digivolution cost by 1.
